# lab-zone

The lab's DNS zone, offered downward so every cluster resolves against one.

<!-- Generated by nix/floe-docs.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-floe-docs -->

## Inputs

| input | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| port | 16 bit unsigned integer; between 0 and 65535 (both inclusive) | `5354` | Port that server answers on. |
| server | string | *(required)* | Where the authoritative server answers, from inside the lab network. Required.  |
| zone | string | *(required)* | The lab's DNS zone, as `lab.test`. Required. |

## Provides

| promise | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| zone | DNS_ZONE | The lab's DNS zone and the server authoritative for it. The only fully portable signature. |

## What it emits

*No lab in this tree renders this floe, so there is nothing linked to read.*
*Its declaration above is the whole of what can be said without one.*
